causal_question: Does an agentic, Arabic-native collection system recover verified electoral evidence that the frozen deterministic B2 pipeline could not recover, without changing the forecast or using agentic judgment to assign predictive effects?

arabic_roster.rule: All 92 rows are evaluated. No row may be dropped, replaced, translated into a new test row, or silently corrected.

historical_input_classes.rule: These are the exact B2-blocked classes. The agent may search for evidence but may not change feature definitions, historical cutoffs, or the B2 result.

allowed_agentic_capabilities: Source discovery inside the frozen source-class policy
Archiving raw source text and provenance
forbidden_actions: Modify F-1 or any F0 artifact, manifest, hash, simulation or coefficient
Assign any predictive effect or forecast delta
Use election-outcome information unavailable at the historical target-year cutoff
Accept evidence from sources outside e_collect_source_policy_v1.json
Delete failed, conflicting, ambiguous or unsupported attempts
Change this protocol or the scoring contract after execution starts
evaluation_order: Freeze protocol, source policy, Arabic normalization, output schema and scoring contract
Run benchmark only on the 92+16 reserved corpus
Independent adjudication of every proposed accepted record
Only after benchmark evaluation may production-wide 2026 collection for Atlas V1 begin

separation_of_roles.collector: Opus multi-agent system or another explicitly declared agentic collector
separation_of_roles.adjudicator: Independent controller; collector self-verification is not final verification
separation_of_roles.forecast_owner: F0 remains frozen; E_collect has no authority to update forecast probabilities

stop_conditions: All 92 Arabic roster rows have a terminal proposed status, and all 16 historical classes have a terminal search report
OR a hard source-policy/provenance violation occurs
OR the collector cannot continue due to access/tooling limits, which must be recorded as DATA_BLOCKED_AGENTIC rather than absence
post_benchmark_rule: A positive E_collect result authorizes only evidence-layer/product work. It does not authorize forecast adjustment; E_reason and any calibrated forecast update require separate preregistration.
